Squirrel’s Acorn Maze

Age 4–5 YearsClass 30 · LogicSkill Maze tracing

Help Squirrel reach the golden acorn — draw a real path through the maze with your finger.

Play the puzzle game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · MAZE TRACING

Squirrel’s Acorn Maze

Help Squirrel find the golden acorn! Draw a line through the maze — and stay on the path.

Acorn reached!

You drew the whole way through the maze. Steady hands!

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

Maze tracing builds planning and pencil control in one. Fingers work best to start; a stylus is a lovely bridge toward pencil-and-paper mazes. Hitting a wall just stops the line — no penalty, redraw any time.

Prefer paper? The Squirrel’s Acorn Maze worksheet prints the same puzzle with room to draw, sort and circle — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
